title: Platonic Representations in the Human Brain: Unsupervised Recovery of Universal Geometry

split.decision: Retain the reproduction shared-image evaluation cohort privately. Carve validation from nonshared observed nsd_id groups using sklearn train_test_split(test_size=0.2, random_state=20261030), separately per subject; all repetitions stay together. Fit all preprocessing on train only. Original stimulus CSV row numbers are trial ids; files sorted by id. Validation scores complete triples; baseline and final candidate fits use training rows only. Materialized train/val trials by subject: [(1, 21600, 5400), (2, 21600, 5400), (3, 17281, 4348), (4, 16267, 4045), (5, 21600, 5400), (6, 17299, 4330), (7, 21600, 5400), (8, 16255, 4057)]. Hidden cohort and raw-array identities verified against archived metadata.
